name: socialmessaging
description: Amazon Web Services End User Messaging Social, also referred to as Social messaging, is a messaging service that enables application developers to incorporate WhatsApp into their existing workflows.

subcommands.name: associate-whatsapp-business-account
subcommands.description: This is only used through the Amazon Web Services console during sign-up to associate your WhatsApp Business Account to your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-whatsapp-flow
subcommands.description: Creates a new WhatsApp Flow.

subcommands.name: create-whatsapp-message-template
subcommands.description: Creates a new WhatsApp message template from a custom definition.

subcommands.name: create-whatsapp-message-template-from-library
subcommands.description: Creates a new WhatsApp message template using a template from Meta's template library.

subcommands.name: create-whatsapp-message-template-media
subcommands.description: Uploads media for use in a WhatsApp message template.

subcommands.name: delete-whatsapp-flow
subcommands.description: Deletes a WhatsApp Flow permanently.

subcommands.name: delete-whatsapp-media-message
subcommands.description: Delete a media object from the WhatsApp service.

subcommands.name: delete-whatsapp-message-media
subcommands.description: Delete a media object from the WhatsApp service.

subcommands.name: delete-whatsapp-message-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a WhatsApp message template.

subcommands.name: deprecate-whatsapp-flow
subcommands.description: Deprecates a published WhatsApp Flow, marking it as no longer recommended for use.

subcommands.name: disassociate-whatsapp-business-account
subcommands.description: Disassociate a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) from your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-linked-whatsapp-business-account
subcommands.description: Get the details of your linked WhatsApp Business Account.

subcommands.name: get-linked-whatsapp-business-account-phone-number
subcommands.description: Retrieve the WABA account id and phone number details of a WhatsApp business account phone number.

subcommands.name: get-whatsapp-flow
subcommands.description: Retrieves the metadata and status of a WhatsApp Flow, including validation errors, preview information, and health status.

subcommands.name: get-whatsapp-flow-preview
subcommands.description: Generates a web preview URL for testing a WhatsApp Flow before publishing.

subcommands.name: get-whatsapp-message-media
subcommands.description: Get a media file from the WhatsApp service.

subcommands.name: get-whatsapp-message-template
subcommands.description: Retrieves a specific WhatsApp message template.

subcommands.name: list-linked-whatsapp-business-accounts
subcommands.description: List all WhatsApp Business Accounts linked to your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all tags associated with a resource, such as a phone number or WABA.

subcommands.name: list-whatsapp-flow-assets
subcommands.description: Lists the assets (Flow JSON definition) of a WhatsApp Flow with presigned download URLs.

subcommands.name: list-whatsapp-flows
subcommands.description: Lists all WhatsApp Flows for a WhatsApp Business Account.

subcommands.name: list-whatsapp-message-templates
subcommands.description: Lists WhatsApp message templates for a specific WhatsApp Business Account.

subcommands.name: list-whatsapp-template-library
subcommands.description: Lists templates available in Meta's template library for WhatsApp messaging.

subcommands.name: post-whatsapp-message-media
subcommands.description: Upload a media file to the WhatsApp service.

subcommands.name: publish-whatsapp-flow
subcommands.description: Publishes a WhatsApp Flow, making it available for use in template messages.

subcommands.name: put-whatsapp-business-account-event-destinations
subcommands.description: Add an event destination to log event data from WhatsApp for a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA).

subcommands.name: send-whatsapp-message
subcommands.description: Send a WhatsApp message.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or overwrites only the specified tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-whatsapp-flow
subcommands.description: Updates the metadata of a WhatsApp Flow, such as its name or categories.

subcommands.name: update-whatsapp-flow-assets
subcommands.description: Updates the Flow JSON definition (assets) of a WhatsApp Flow.

subcommands.name: update-whatsapp-message-template
subcommands.description: Updates an existing WhatsApp message template.
